extracted.intended_audience: researchers, institutions, and grants administrators applying for or managing U.S. DOE Office of Science grants and cooperative agreements
extracted.subtask_short: DOE Office of Science grant compliance
extracted.subtask_description: Agency-level guidance for preparing, submitting, and managing grant applications and awards for the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science, including merit review expectations and the federal regulations that govern awards. Applies to applicants and awarded institutions and their administrative staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructions for preparing and submitting grant applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for preparing and submitting grant applications are contained in the Funding Opportunity Announcements posted on this site, at www.grants.gov, and at www.FedConnect.net.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must follow the specific instructions in the FOA and the systems (Grants.gov, FedConnect). Current guidance about grants may be found in the regulations and documents cited on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merit Review of Grant Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Science reviews the scientific and technical merit of all applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Office of Science 'Merit Review System' (as published in the Federal Register, March 11, 1991) for the detailed merit review process and criteria that will be applied to applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory requirements for awards made after December 19, 2014
rubrics_metrics.description: For new or renewal awards made after December 19, 2014: 2 CFR 200 – Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Award; 2 CFR 910 – Department of Energy Implementation of Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards; 10 CFR 605 – The Office of Science Financial Assistance Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These rules establish the basic requirements that the Office of Science (SC) and its awardees must follow for post-December 19, 2014 awards (financial management, cost principles, audits, administrative requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory requirements for awards made before December 19, 2014
rubrics_metrics.description: For new or renewal awards made before December 19, 2014: 10 CFR 600 - Department of Energy Financial Assistance Regulations; 10 CFR 605 - The Office of Science Financial Assistance Program Rule; 2 CFR 215 - Uniform Administrative Requirements for Grants and Other Agreements with Institutions of Higher Education, Hospitals and Other Non-Profit Organizations (A-110); 2 CFR 220 - Cost Principles for Educational Institutions (A-21); 2 CFR 230 - Cost Principles for Non-Profit Organizations (A-122, does not apply to Colleges and Universities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These earlier regulations set the requirements applicable to awards issued under the pre-2014 regulatory regime; applicants and awardees must determine which set of regulations applies to their award based on award date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit and federal policy references
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB Circular A-133 - Audits of States, Local Government and Non-Profit Organizations; OMB Policy Statements; Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) - Part 31, Cost Principles for Profit-making Organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These documents are cited as relevant policy and audit guidance and may impose additional requirements (audit standards, cost principles) that applicants and awardees must follow.
